title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Commercial Placement Experience Rating
content:
**Commercial placement experience modifier.** For a commercial placement priced under the commercial placement schedule of the **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs** (Lender-Placed Flood – Commercial Building tier), the rated amount of a commercial placement is multiplied by a modifier worked out from the program's own claim experience, chosen by how long the program has been in force:

| Program in force | Modifier |
|---|---|
| 36 months or more | 1 plus one half (0.5) of the amount by which the program's 36-month commercial placement loss ratio exceeds 0.40 (a ratio below 0.40 lowers it), kept no lower than 0.85 and no higher than 1.25 |
| At least 12 but fewer than 36 months | 1.10 when any claim payment was issued under the program's certificates in the last 12 months; 0.97 when none was |
| Fewer than 12 months | 1.00 |

**The 36-month commercial placement loss ratio** is the claim payments issued under the program's certificates in the last 36 months less the claim payments voided in those 36 months, divided by the lender payments the program received in those 36 months; it is zero when no lender payment was received in that window.

**Calendar.** Months in force for a commercial placement are the whole calendar months from the program effective date to today, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached; a window of the last N months covers every entry dated on a day from which fewer than N such whole months have passed by today.

### Questions answered from the rule

- *A program in force 40 months shows net claim payments of 9,000 dollars against lender payments of 36,000 dollars over 36 months (hypothetical).* The ratio is 0.25, which is 0.15 below 0.40; one half of that lowers the modifier to 0.925.
- *The same program with no lender payment in the window.* The ratio is zero; 1 less one half of 0.40 is 0.80, kept at the floor of 0.85.
- *A program in force 30 months with no claim payment issued in the last 12 months.* 0.97.
- *A program in force 11 months.* 1.00, whatever its claims.
